description: Pollution from wildfires Cumulative Effects products is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. The Regional Air Quality Deterministic Prediction System FireWork (RAQDPS-FW) carries out physics and chemistry calculations, including emissions from active wildfires, to arrive at deterministic predictions of chemical species concentration of interest to air quality, such as fine particulate matter PM2.5 (2.5 micrometers in diameter or less). Geographical coverage is Canada and the United States. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Climate Change Canada | Environnement et Changement climatique Canada. Its tags are Régional; Particules fines; Feux de forêts, Incendie de forêt, Prévision, Qualité de l'air, Émissions atmosphériques. It offers 2 resource(s) in WMS. The portal shows 2020-12-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
